_note: Real verification dates, distinct from build time. Build time must never be presented as a data-freshness claim: it says when the site was compiled, not when anything was checked. These values are the only dates allowed next to content, catalogue or performance data, and the only ones used in structured data. Update them when the corresponding review actually happens.
_brokerCountriesNote: Date the broker country lists in brokers.json were last checked against each broker's own published terms. null means they have not been re-checked since they were recorded, and the brokers page says so. The monthly check (docs/BROKER-COUNTRY-CHECK.md) sets this; never set it without doing the check.
